name: Goyal Associates Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Goyal Associates Ltd is engaged in Investment and financing activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GAL is registered as a non systematically
 important non-deposit taking non-banking 
finance company. It provides services 
for:
a) Micro Enterprise loans
b) SME Loans
c) Vehicle Loans
d) Agro based Loans
e) Loans to Micro Financial Institutions 
f) NBFCs & share trading
g) Other financial-related activities of NBFCs etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 66.7 to 22.2 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 255 days to 824 days
